title: The drugstore's one postcard
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The drugstore sells one postcard of Small Wood: the bay, faded, from before Wood was born. He buys ten. The CLERK asks who he knows in ten places. He says one place, ten times.

panels.composition: The drugstore's card rack: Christmas cards, and one slot of postcards, all the same: the bay, faded, a color photo gone blue. WOOD taking the whole slot.

image.prompt: a drugstore card rack with a single slot of identical faded postcards of a bay, a young man taking the whole stack, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The postcard: the bay, the boat launch, the shack newer, the water bluer than it is.

image.prompt: close on a faded color postcard of a small bay with a boat launch and a newer bait shack, the colors gone blue, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Ten. Who do you know in ten places.

image.prompt: a drugstore clerk at a register ringing up a stack of postcards for a young man, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood out on the sidewalk with the ten cards in his coat, the real bay at the end of the street, gray, not blue. The dog.

image.prompt: a young man on a rainy sidewalk with a small dog, a gray bay at the end of the street, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Ten postcards, one place. The reply of Dec 22 comes from this stack.
